title: Ruins of Constellas

[[Image:Ruins of Constellas.jpg|thumb|Ruins of Constellas]]
The '''Ruins of Constellas''' is an area of [[Felwood]].  [[Xavathras]], and his group of Jadefire [[satyr]], inhabit the area.  Judging by the remnants of the architecture, and the existence of a [[moonwell]], it used to be one of the many [[night elven]] settlements near [[Mount Hyjal]].  This settlement was presumably destroyed in the [[Great Sundering]].  The moonwell has since become corrupted with [[Fel]] energy, and is being cultivated by Xavathras on behalf of [[Xavaric]].
